title: ‘Amitabh Bachchan is a hero for us, but he’s allowed to be human': Abhishek Bachchan
description: Amitabh Bachchan is celebrating his 84th birthday on October 11 with numerous wishes from admirers. On the occasion, here's recalling the time when Abhishek Bachchan shared insights about their family dynamics and his father's dual role as a star and family man. He also spoke about how his parents feel about his career and how seeing his father at home despite being a superstar, taught him to stay detach from fame early on in life.

title: 'Jailer 2' budget and Rajinikanth’s salary revealed
description: Rajinikanth's much-awaited 'Jailer 2' is being produced with a staggering budget ranging from Rs 240 crore to Rs 300 crore. Reports suggest that he is set to earn Rs 110 crore, along with a percentage of the film's profits. If the sequel thrives at the box office, his earnings could soar to around Rs 180 crore.

title: Mamitha Baiju to reportedly make Telugu debut with ‘Jai Hanuman’
description: Mamitha Baiju is reportedly making her Telugu film debut with Jai Hanuman, directed by Prasanth Varma. The film features Rishab Shetty, who plays the deity Lord Hanuman. Additionally, the project is a sequel to the Telugu superhero film HanuMan, further expanding the Prasanth Varma Cinematic Universe. Baiju has several upcoming films across different languages alongside her anticipated Telugu project.

title: 'Drishyam 3' BO Day 10 [LIVE]: Ajay starrer set to cross Rs 300 cr net
description: Ajay Devgn's latest offering, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion,' has marked a remarkable achievement at the box office, surpassing Rs 400 crore globally since its release. The film gained momentum with an impressive Rs 245 crore in its opening week and maintained its box office strength thereafter. By day 10, its net earnings in India stood at approximately Rs 291.96 crore.

title: Kamal Haasan wishes Amitabh Bachchan on his 84th birthday
description: Kamal Haasan took to social media to send heartfelt birthday wishes to Amitabh Bachchan as he turned 84. Haasan applauded Bachchan's legendary voice and distinctive acting style. Fans thronged outside Bachchan’s home, celebrating the occasion with excitement. Despite limited collaborations, their long-standing friendship shines bright in the film industry, as both continue to be powerful influencers with new projects on the horizon.

title: Prabhas wishes Amitabh Bachchan on 84th birthday
description: Amitabh Bachchan recently celebrated his 84th birthday, receiving wishes from many celebrities in the film industry. Prabhas shared a heartfelt message on Instagram, expressing gratitude for Amitabh's influence. The two actors collaborated in the film 'Kalki 2898 AD', where Amitabh portrayed Ashwatthama and Prabhas played Bhairava. Director Nag Ashwin highlighted Prabhas’s support during filming and his willingness to be challenged in scenes.

title: Kher explores loneliness; stardom stays off his shoulders
description: Anupam Kher says he avoids the loneliness of stardom by living a normal life instead of in an “ivory tower.” The 71-year-old actor is touring the US and Canada with his first musical, “Jaane Pehchaane Anjaane,” which explores loneliness across three generations, and has won warm audience responses.

title: Raveena Tandon begins shooting for Shivarajkumar’s ‘A For Anand’
description: Raveena Tandon has officially started filming for the new Kannada movie 'A For Anand' in Bengaluru. This project represents the actress's first collaboration with renowned star Shivarajkumar, who is currently juggling numerous projects. Directed by MG Srinivas and produced by Geetha Pictures, 'A For Anand' adds to Raveena's impressive portfolio, which includes hits like 'KGF: Chapter 2' and 'Upendra'. Her last appearance was in the comedy 'Welcome To The Jungle'.

title: 'Jailer 2' star Mirnaa reveals Rajinikanth’s strict diet
description: Fans are buzzing with anticipation for Rajinikanth's return in 'Jailer 2' as Muthuvel Pandian. Actress Mirnaa recently shared insights about his disciplined lifestyle, which includes avoiding spicy and white foods, and a morning workout routine to maintain peak fitness. She also painted a picture of Rajinikanth's humorous and spiritual side, reminiscing about their enjoyable moments together. Mark your calendars for the film's release on October 15, 2026.

title: Vijay says Balaji wanted Amitabh Bachchan, Mohanlal, Kamal Haasan for ‘Seethakathi’
description: Vijay Sethupathi recalled humorous moments with director Balaji Tharaneetharan while discussing his film choices. He explained his decision to choose 'Seethakathi' as his 25th film over '96'. The actor highlighted the depth of the character in 'Seethakathi' that resonated with him. Sethupathi also discussed how art can influence society through storytelling. His latest film 'Baththa' continues to perform well at the box office following its release.

title: Kottayam Nazeer recalls gifting Rajinikanth
description: Kottayam Nazeer recently recounted a memorable experience meeting superstar Rajinikanth while filming 'Jailer 2'. During their interaction, Nazeer gifted Rajinikanth a book featuring his artworks, which the superstar reviewed with enthusiasm. They engaged in a pleasant conversation, and Rajinikanth expressed his excitement about Nazeer's paintings. This interaction left Nazeer feeling as if he was dreaming, marking a highlight in his career.

title: Ravi Teja and Vivek Athreya launch ‘Thulabharam’ with pooja ceremony
description: Ravi Teja has begun a new project titled 'Thulabharam' with director Vivek Athreya, which will be a crime comedy. The film's launch event occurred in Hyderabad with cast members including Priyanka Arul Mohan and Anaswara Rajan. Regular shooting is scheduled to commence on October 17, 2026, after the initial ceremony. 'Thulabharam' will be produced by Laxman and Srini Rao under Bridge Productions banner.

title: Hilary Duff posts about vacation with Mandy Moore, Gaby Dalkin, and others from the ‘mom group chat'
description: Hilary Duff recently shared highlights from her trip to Riviera Nayarit, Mexico, where she connected with fellow celebrity moms, including Mandy Moore and Gaby Dalkin. The group indulged in relaxing spa sessions, spirited board games, and vibrant cocktails. In an interview, Mandy reflected on how motherhood fosters deep friendships, while Ashley Tisdale recounted her journey of navigating away from toxic mom groups, expressing feelings of sadness over cliques.

title: Vijay Antony's 'Appa Kutty' locks release date for this Diwali

Going head-to-head with Suriya's 'Scene' and Nayanthara's 'Mookkuthi Amman', the film has completed post-production and will soon launch its promotional campaign, aspiring to stand out in the bustling holiday film market.

title: Rajinikanth’s 230 avatars feature in special Navratri Kolu

This year's display features over 230 photos showcasing his cinematic journey through multiple films. Karthik, a devoted fan, began this tradition three years ago and has continued expanding it each year. The temple conducts daily pujas and offers prasadam to visitors, enhancing the community's connection to the actor.

title: Dileep says fans’ prayers helped him through 10-year ordeal
description: In a heartfelt moment at the Dileep Fans Association event in Qatar, Dileep reflected on the steadfast loyalty of his fans throughout a decade filled with challenges. He shared his struggles to speak out due to ongoing legal barriers, and expressed deep gratitude for their prayers and support. His latest film, 'Neekkam', explores a complex psychological game centered on a father-daughter bond.

title: Chiranjeevi calls Amitabh Bachchan his ‘dearest Guru Ji’ on 84th birthday
description: Chiranjeevi shared his heartfelt birthday wishes for Amitabh Bachchan, commending his unwavering passion for cinema and artistry. As Bachchan marked his 84th year, an outpouring of affection from fans and industry peers followed. Chiranjeevi noted Bachchan's genuine humility, a trait that distinguishes him. Their past collaboration in 'Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy' remains noteworthy. Meanwhile, Chiranjeevi is gearing up for the release of 'Kaaka' around the Sankranti festival.

title: Mrunal Thakur calls brother her ‘first baby’ in heartfelt birthday wish
description: Mrunal Thakur expressed her love for her brother Mandar on his birthday through a heartfelt message. She described him as her first baby and acknowledged the important life lessons he had taught her. The actress reflected on their close bond and promised to always care for him, no matter how much he grows. Additionally, she shared cherished memories with him through a selection of pictures.
